anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
No active or closed trades despite active strategies, suggesting potential issues with strategy execution or market conditions.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential inactivity or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and adjust trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions and capable of executing trades.
Evaluate AI system configuration and ensure it is correctly set up to generate learning cycles and trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance and potential downtime, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Assess and potentially recalibrate trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and capable of executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: Active strategies with no trades suggest a disconnect that could lead to missed trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Review AI system settings and logs to diagnose why no learning cycles or opportunities are being generated.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could result in missed insights and trading opportunities, reducing the platform's competitive edge.
